## What's new

In this update, I primarily re-arranged the UI a little and added some quality-of-life options for the editor (the changelog turned out to be quite large!)

- Moved the BPM and time signature inputs to the top of the timing menu
- Added an option to reverse the scroll direction of the editor
- Added an option to shorten exported file names, because of the Windows path limit.
- Added the option "View > Timeline > Show notes" in the editor, to be able to see the waveform behind them more clearly
- Split the settings menu into a "General" and "Advanced" category
- Updated UNANIMATED integration (for v0.1.14)
  - Added all new actions
  - Parameters for notes are now decimals (The new values are the old ones divided by 10)
  - True/False inputs are now done with a checkbox
  - Added a "Hold Duration" number input for more control
- Bundled some toggles in the editor under one "Quick Settings" category
- Removed the option to use the old update button, as the auto updater appears to work fine.
- Removed unnecessary menu options from the "View" menu

I also want to share this website I created for this editor: https://unbeatable.eriko.dev/ --- It closely resembles this project's README, and is maybe more easily accessible than the GitHub page.

**Happy mapping!**
